contentHtml:
Battery gone in an hour, laptop dying with charge still showing, or a case that has started to bulge? I replace laptop batteries across Stretton and Brisbane's southside, either at your place or as a drop-off, using good-quality compatible cells. I run a free health check first, so you are never paying for a battery you do not actually need. Prices for most models run $50 to $150 depending on the laptop.

Sometimes it is not the battery at all

Rapid drain, sudden shutdowns and a percentage that jumps around can point to a tired battery, but they can just as easily be old drivers, the wrong power settings or a calibration issue. I check the real numbers first, the charge cycles, health status and how it holds up under load, then give you a straight recommendation rather than selling you a part you can do without.

Onsite or drop-off, whichever suits

Cannot get away? I will come to you fully equipped and swap it on the spot, no need to pack anything up or find a lift. Happier to drop it off? Most drop-offs are done the same day. Either way you get a compatible battery that meets or beats the original spec, fitted without damaging the laptop, and backed by a warranty.

What is included

  • Onsite replacement at your home or office, with minimal downtime.
  • Drop-off service, most finished the same day.
  • Battery health diagnostics, a clear report on cycles and condition with an honest recommendation.
  • Repairs and tune-ups, since a recalibration or power-management tweak sometimes buys back the life without a new battery.
  • Quality replacements that match or exceed OEM standard, professionally installed and under warranty.
  • Safe disposal of the old battery, recycled to local standards rather than going to landfill.

Signs your battery needs attention

  • Rapid drain, a full charge lasting a fraction of what it used to.
  • Sudden shutdowns, the laptop dying even though there is charge showing.
  • Overheating or swelling, a safety issue. Stop using it and bring it in.
  • Only runs on the charger, unplug it and it dies straight away.
  • Won't charge past a set point, or the percentage sticks and jumps.

If the battery is fine but the laptop is still slow, a tune-up often helps, and for anything else see my laptop repairs page. Send me the details for a quote or call 0477 319 160, with no call-out fee anywhere on Stretton.
